ValidationRule.description: Inserts and clones must start clean; updates enforce a status ladder, a budget change policy and a frozen identity once approved, using ISNEW, ISCLONE, ISCHANGED and PRIORVALUE.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( ISNEW(), IF( ISCLONE(), OR( Is_Approved__c, NULLVALUE(Spent__c, 0) > 0, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft')), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Kickoff_At__c)), Kickoff_At__c < NOW()), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Epoch_Seconds__c)), Epoch_Seconds__c < UNIXTIMESTAMP(NOW())) ), AND(Is_Approved__c, ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), LEN(GETSESSIONID()) = 0) ), OR( AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), OR( CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c)), 'Draft', 0, 'Planning', 1, 'Active', 2, 'On Hold', 2, 'Completed', 3, 'Cancelled', 3, -1) - CASE(TEXT(Status__c), 'Draft', 0, 'Planning', 1, 'Active', 2, 'On Hold', 2, 'Completed', 3, 'Cancelled', 3, -1) >= 2, AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Cancelled'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Planning'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), NOT(Is_Approved__c)) ) ), AND( ISCHANGED(Budget__c), OR( Budget__c < NULLVALUE(Spent__c, 0), AND(Is_Approved__c, ABS(Budget__c - BLANKVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Budget__c), 0)) > 0.2 * MAX(1, BLANKVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Budget__c), 0))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), Budget__c <> PRIORVALUE(Budget__c)) ) ), AND( PRIORVALUE(Is_Approved__c), OR( ISCHANGED(Code__c), ISCHANGED(Account__c), ISCHANGED(Parent_Project__c), AND(ISCHANGED(End_Date__c), End_Date__c > PRIORVALUE(End_Date__c)), AND(ISCHANGED(Start_Date__c), Start_Date__c < PRIORVALUE(Start_Date__c)) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This change violates the project change-control policy.
